question: During the first year, the population of a town increased by 10%s and during the next year the population decreased by 10%. If the total population of the town was 19,800 at the end of the second year. find the population size at the beginning of the first year.
solution:
**Given:**

Population increased by 10% in the first year and decreased by 10% in the second year. The final population at the end of the second year = 19,800.

**Formula Used:**

Final Population = Initial Population × (1 + Rate of increase) × (1 - Rate of decrease)
